facts: Parties: Vantage Industries Ltd (Buyer), Northgate Software Ltd (Seller); the Company is Delamere Retail Group plc.
This Agreement is dated 17 June 2026; Closing is scheduled for 12 August 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 17 June 2026), either party may terminate.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 12 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 30 October 2026.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Present: 2 directors (of 5). The meeting was quorate. RESOLVED to approve entry into the Share Purchase Agreement.
Article 11: the quorum for board meetings is three directors.
